final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and explicitly conceded the two missing compliance predicates: no evidence of completed disclosure and no evidence of approved risk acceptance. The response is a narrower interpretation of the same record, not new proof. That reframing is directionally more accurate than an unqualified certification defense, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved policy condition, not a disclosed-and-satisfied condition. Under the policy text, a named launch use case with open legal review and named customer commitments remains materially unresolved unless disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance. On the present record, certification may be arguable as a future conditional path, but the current packet remains suspicious because the required support link showing that the condition will in fact be met is absent.
